text:
Using water for bladder washout risks osmotic lysis of red blood cells, urothelial irritation, and—if absorbed—hemolysis, hyponatremia, and hypervolemia, so sterile normal saline or prescribed irrigation fluid should be used instead; this is a stronger safety concern than the listed options. If forced to choose from the given options, I would not select either as the primary risk.  
CONFIDENCE: 70
